The value is now supplied as a distribution-level `--application-version` flag on the `assemble` command. It is shown on the sign-in page and the primary navigation bar. When nobody sets it, `window.applicationVersion` is `undefined` and nothing is rendered. The change is PR #1815 (commit `9f0c6aa`) in `openmrs-esm-core`, but no ticket is linked to it.

**How it is supplied at assembly time**
- The CLI option `application-version` is declared in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:345-350` and passed to the assemble command at line 368.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.ts:392-404` writes it as the top-level `version` in `routes.registry.json`, and only when it is non-empty.

**How the browser gets it**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:104-124` reads `initialRouteMap.version` and defines `window.applicationVersion`.
  - Unset, null or blank gives `undefined`.
  - The literal `prerelease` gives the translated "Prerelease" text, or "Local" when running locally (`run.ts:111-115`).
  - Any other string is used as-is.

**Where it is shown by default**
- The sign-in page renders it at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx:258`, styled by `.versionText` in `login.scss:47`.
- The primary navigation bar renders it at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/navbar/navbar.component.tsx:65`.

**What it reads when unset**
- Nothing. The tests confirm the top-level version is omitted when the value is missing, null or empty (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.test.ts:477-494`).
- The PR description says an unset version reads "Prerelease". The current code does not do that; "Prerelease" only appears when the version is explicitly `prerelease` (`en.json:69`, `translations.ts:97`).

**Change and ticket**
- PR #1815, "(feat) Add a distribution-controlled version property", merged 2026-08-21 as commit `9f0c6aa831f37ffcaf167a7096b07ec3e96a0431`. Its ticket field is empty, and the Jira link in the body is an unfilled `O3-` placeholder, so I could not identify a ticket.
- The PR description is out of date in two places: it names `--openmrs-version` and `window.openmrsVersion`, but the code uses `--application-version` and `window.applicationVersion`.
